children: announced on Tuesday that the European Commission approved a more convenient dosing regimen for its cancer therapy, Libtayo, that will cut patients' clinic visits and potentially halve their infusion times.
The decision greenlights a higher 700 mg dose infused over 30 minutes once every six weeks after an initial 12 weeks of Libtayo 350 mg administered once every three weeks over 30 minutes.
Concurrently, the EC approved an option to allow those who well-tolerated the first Libtayo 350 mg dose over 30 minutes to cut their subsequent infusion times to 15–30 minutes at the same dose level.
